## 1. Read First: Five Issues That Could Derail the Meeting

1. **Open connectivity defect.** TCK-40162 ("Lumen Lock Pro (Graphite) keeps disconnecting from Wi-Fi") has been open about 84 days at normal priority. Its twin, TCK-40161, is closed with the same subject and timestamp, so it may be a duplicate. **Get a written status from Support before any expansion is proposed.**

Hotels usually run guest Wi-Fi with captive portals on shared bands, so this is a likely root cause of the disconnects and a risk for both new properties. Note that the ticket names "Lock Pro (Graphite)," which does not appear in the knowledge base. Confirm the model.
